name: refactor_dockerfile_multistage_build
description: Single-stage Dockerfile shipping build-essential in the runtime image -> multi-stage build with a slim runtime stage; structural oracle
prompts: The Dockerfile in this workspace builds a FastAPI service, but it installs build-essential and libpq-dev (needed only to compile psycopg2 at pip-install time) into the image that ships to production - bloating it and widening its attack surface. Convert it to a multi-stage build: a builder stage on the full python:3.12 image that installs the build tools and pip- installs requirements.txt (e.g. with --prefix or a venv), and a runtime stage on python:3.12-slim that copies the installed packages from the builder with COPY --from=... and contains NO apt-get installs or build tooling of its own. The runtime behavior must be unchanged: same app code copied in, same EXPOSE 8000, and the same uvicorn app.main:app command on 0.0.0.0:8000.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential libpq-dev
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app ./app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

test_setup_files.check_multistage.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

raw = Path("Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]

from_idxs = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.upper().startswith("FROM ")]
assert len(from_idxs) >= 2, (
    f"expected a multi-stage build (>= 2 FROM instructions), found {len(from_idxs)}")

final_from = lines[from_idxs[-1]]
assert re.search(r"python:3\.\d+-slim", final_from), (
    f"the runtime (final) stage must use a python:3.x-slim base, got: {final_from}")

builder_stage = lines[from_idxs[0]:from_idxs[-1]]
final_stage = lines[from_idxs[-1]:]

builder_all = " ".join(builder_stage)
assert "pip install" in builder_all and "requirements.txt" in builder_all, (
    "dependencies must still be installed from requirements.txt in the builder stage")

final_all = " ".join(final_stage)
for tool in ("build-essential", "gcc", "apt-get install"):
    assert tool not in final_all, (
        f"the runtime stage still contains {tool!r} - build tooling must stay in the builder stage")

assert any(re.search(r"COPY\s+--from=", l, re.IGNORECASE) for l in final_stage), (
    "the runtime stage never copies the built artifacts (no COPY --from=...)")

cmd_all = " ".join(l for l in final_stage if l.upper().startswith(("CMD ", "ENTRYPOINT ")))
for needle in ("uvicorn", "app.main:app", "0.0.0.0", "8000"):
    assert needle in cmd_all, f"the runtime CMD changed - missing {needle!r}"

assert any(l.upper().startswith("EXPOSE ") and "8000" in l for l in final_stage), (
    "EXPOSE 8000 missing from the runtime stage")

assert any(re.search(r"^COPY\s+(--\S+\s+)*app\b", l, re.IGNORECASE) for l in final_stage) or \
       any(re.search(r"^COPY\s+(--\S+\s+)*\.\s", l, re.IGNORECASE) for l in final_stage), (
    "the application code is never copied into the runtime stage")

print("PASS multi-stage structural checks")

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential libpq-dev
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --prefix=/install -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /install /usr/local
COPY app ./app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
